description.value: Five Forks Bar & Grill is a full-service bar and restaurant on the Lougheed Highway in Mission, BC, serving regional cuisine with a broad menu of starters, mains, wings, tacos, and bowls. The kitchen emphasises fresh, high-quality ingredients and caters to a range of dietary needs, including gluten-wise and vegetarian dishes. The venue also offers private event spaces and catering, making it a social anchor along a main cycling corridor east of Vancouver.
